title: Investment Product expert - Onsite
jobDescription:
Job Profile Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Create and update investment product marketing materials for sales and relationship managers using Power Point, mainly covering structured products, investment funds, and alternative investments. • Lead the end-to-end process of creating client-ready marketing materials for investment products. • Create client-ready marketing materials for in-focus investment products across established platforms, including Weekly Top Convictions, Market Outlook product offerings, and Structured Products booklets • Contribute to Market Outlook campaigns by distilling complex research and product information into clear, concise, and client-friendly marketing materials • Ensure content quality through editing and proofreading and publish it across various distribution channels using our content management tools. • Maintain and update investment product-related content and marketing materials. • Perform data analytics tasks and automate processes along the Content Value Chain. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION Personal and Social • Client-centric approach for all deliverables • Actively taking ownership/responsibility and passion to come up with new things to drive investment product sales • Positive attitude, flexible, and adaptable • Attention to detail and high-quality standards • Independent worker with excellent communication and coordination skills • Highly motivated with strong interpersonal skills Professional and Technical • Minimum 5 years of experience in the financial products industry with a strong understanding of financial markets • In-depth knowledge of investment products, including structured products, investment funds, and alternative investments, with a strong focus on structured products Solid understanding of investment product performance and working knowledge of derivatives, particularly to interpret structured product pay-offs • Hands-on experience with Bloomberg and Morningstar Direct, with the ability to source, analyse, and interpret data for investment content development • Proven ability to create high-quality, client-ready investment product marketing materials, particularly in presentation (Power Point) format • Strong capability to translate complex research material into clear, concise, and impactful marketing content (e.g., Market Outlook campaigns or similar initiatives) • Excellent English skills with strong writing, editing, and communication capabilities • Project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables across content platforms • Degree in Finance or a related field • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Power Point, Excel, Word, Share Point); familiarity with content management systems and marketing automation tools • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and adherence to internal compliance standards

title: Assistant Manager - Equity Research
jobDescription:
Job Profile JOB DETAILS JOB SPECIFICATION Position: Assistant Manager
- Equity Research Location: Mumbai/ Gurgaon Reporting to: Senior Manager
- Investment Research & Analytics KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Investment Research and Idea Generation • Conduct independent, bottom-up and thematic equity research across emerging and international markets with a focus on idea generation rather than static deliverables. • Actively contribute new investment ideas and continuously revisit and refine an existing internal idea universe of ~250 companies. • Develop and articulate differentiated views on macro, country, sector, and company-specific developments. • Quickly understand and assess key business drivers, KPIs, valuation frameworks, and risk factors across diverse sectors. • Maintain strong working knowledge of emerging and international markets, with familiarity across
- India, Brazil, Chile, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Greece, Poland, Romania, Kazakhstan, South Africa, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia. • Cover a broad and flexible set of sectors, including but not limited to
- Utilities, Energy, Banking & NBFCs, Consumer Discretionary, Auto Components, Mining, Metals, and Coal. While deep specialization across all sectors is not expected, the ability to rapidly get up to speed and form credible, investable views is essential. • Stay updated on market trends and macroeconomic events impacting investment strategies. • Knowledge of coding language is preferred (VBA, Python etc) Writing & Communication • Produce high-quality market commentaries that demonstrate clarity of thought, balance, and investment judgment. • Writing style must align with buy-side expectation i.e., insightful, concise, and opinionated rather than descriptive. • Participate actively in weekly client calls every and client’s internal Emerging Markets team meeting • Be comfortable in open-ended, idea-driven discussions, often without rigid agendas. Client Engagement • Engage with the client primarily through intellectual contribution rather than administrative or commercial interaction. • Operate effectively in a setting where the client is largely unreachable via email and responsiveness is driven by idea relevance and quality. • Maintain proactive engagement even during periods with no immediate deliverables Engagement Characteristics • Highly relationship- and intellect-driven • Minimal process handholding • Success measured by idea relevance, insight depth, and consistency of contribution, not volume of output Responsible for developing strong working relationships with team members (research analysts, assistant managers) to ensure they are sufficiently motivated and connected with you • Identifying their skill sets as well as areas of strengths and improvements • Charting career path for members and provide guidance and coaching • Addressing people issues (conflicts, discipline, behaviour etc) Learning and Development: • Responsible for identifying training needs of team members • Coordinating with training SPOCs in developing new training modules, deliver existing training modules and process improvement initiatives • Identify self-learning and growth opportunities • Research insights contribution: Support Aranca Investment Research team’s efforts in developing inhouse research insights through articles, blog updates, infographics and other forms through own contribution as well as encouraging/coordinating team members to contribute through their content writeups POSITION REQUIREMENTS Functional Requirements: • MBAs (Finance) from top tier institutes, CFAs, CAs • 5+ years of genuine buy-side equity research experience. • Strong confidence in forming and articulating independent investment opinions. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • High intellectual curiosity and ability to thrive in an unstructured, thinking-intensive environment. • Proven ability to engage senior investment professionals as a peer. • Strong project management, time management and multi-tasking capabilities Soft skills & Behavioral skills: • Top notch analytical and communication skills • Exceptional writing skills, including writing samples • Strong work ethic • Detail oriented • Strong interpersonal abilities • Pro-active and highly motivated • “Do what it takes” attitude to meet aggressive deadlines and manage team

title: Senior Analyst - Private Credit
jobDescription: Job Profile Deal Screening & Underwriting • Prepare quick-turn investment profiles / teasers for live deals • Build detailed financial models (cash flow, liquidity, debt schedules) • Conduct downside / scenario analysis and identify key risk triggers • Support Investment Committee (IC) memos with clear recommendations Credit Analysis • Analyze financial statements, leverage, DSCR, interest coverage • Assess business model, industry risks, and capital structure • Evaluate sources & uses, transaction structure, and sponsor dynamics Bond / Loan Pricing Valuation: • Build and maintain private credit valuation and pricing models (DCF-based) for illiquid bonds and loan-format securities (bullet & amortizing), including SAR/local currency instruments • Develop credit spread frameworks using financial KPIs (leverage, ICR, cash flows), market benchmarks, and illiquidity/structural adjustments • Perform scenario analysis, recovery modelling, and sensitivity analysis to support fair value (IFRS Level 3), NAV reporting, and investment decisions Portfolio Monitoring • Track portfolio performance, liquidity, and covenant compliance • Identify early warning signals and covenant breaches • Support quarterly reviews and ongoing credit updates Execution Support • Handle multiple live deals with tight turnaround timelines • Work closely with onshore teams / PMs / deal teams • Maintain high quality and consistency across deliverables Functional Requirements: • CA / MBA Finance / CFA preferred • Strong experience in credit research / private credit / leveraged finance • Hands-on financial modelling (cash flow-based) • Exposure to IC memos / credit notes / deal write-ups • Understanding of capital structures, covenants, and debt instruments • Ability to work in high deal-flow, fast turnaround environments. Added Advantage: • Experience with direct lending / private credit funds / KPOs serving buyside • Exposure to monthly cash flow modelling, PIK interest, amortization schedules • Loan pricing valuation models • Portfolio monitoring / covenant tracking experience • Tools: Bloomberg / Capital IQ / Excel (advanced)

title: Deal Advisory-Senior Consultant/Engagement Lead
jobDescription: Job Profile KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The role would involve providing support to Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, and Family Office clients (global) of Aranca for their mandates and research requirements. The opportunity is ideal for professionals who have 2-10 years of experience in investment banking, M&A advisory and private equity support and are interested in being a part of our growing investment banking practice. Story boarding and workshopping of marketing collaterals such as, but not limited to pitch books, IMs, PPMs, and company profiles Preparing target industry databases and company profiles. Create financial and valuation models including but not limited to cash flow models, merger models, and LBO models. Conduct target valuation via methods including DCF, Trading Comparables and Precedent Transactions through databases and/or company financial filings, press articles and other sources. Assist in pre and post transaction due diligence activities for both buy side and sell side. Performing unstructured financial analysis on data provided and arriving at conclusions / identifying issues. Assess data accuracy and reasonableness in areas such as financial reporting, market sizing, valuation, etc. and follow-up directly with clients and third-parties appropriately to achieve necessary understanding and to resolve anomalies. Monitor and analyze market trends, M&A activity, and regulatory developments relevant to the target industries. Collaborate with other teams in Aranca such as Growth Advisory or Technology, Research & Advisory for example, to ensure smooth and efficient execution of transactions and projects. Support senior advisors/bankers in client interactions, including communication and coordination with clients, legal advisors, and other parties involved in transactions. Maintaining business contacts (i.e. it is our expectation that consultants will make a positive commitment to maintaining contact with people they meet on transactions, who may become important providers of work in the future). To provide support/assistance for proposals/business development activities. To prepare first draft engagement letters, demonstrating T&R technical/risk management awareness. Handle client communication with multiple stakeholders in the client’s organization. Handling adhoc research requests as per client or team requirements.

title: Manager - Growth Advisory
jobDescription:
Job Profile KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
This is a leadership position where the individual will be responsible for managing a fast growing practice in the areas of business research and advisory practice. He/she would directly report to AVP, Business Research. Such a person should possess a strong blend of strategic and analytical thinking and operations execution. Analytical thinking is required to enable him / her to structure and guide research / consulting assignments with clients, and manage the project internally. To ensure smooth execution of all projects and business, he /she will need to possess excellent operations management capabilities. Operational responsibility will include grooming talent, managing large and growing teams, developing internal methodologies and continuously refining training modules and ongoing process improvement, ensuring high scores on customer satisfaction surveys. He / she will work closely with senior management team in developing and implementing strategies for new business lines, in business development support and in managing the company’s growth This role involves the responsibility of managing multiple clients across the world and this may also involve overseas travel. Key Skills: Given above set of responsibilities, this individual: Is expected to display strong theoretical grounding and possess the ability to multi-task and work on several types of projects / areas. - which could include working to aggressive deadlines, managing team issues etc.

title: Engagement Lead - Procurement Research
jobDescription:
Job Profile Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
An Engagement Lead is responsible for all activities related to sourcing/procurement assignments. The assignments will include conducting Market Intelligence (MI) study, BCCS study, building cost models, price forecasting etc. The role will involve extensive secondary and primary research with respect to supply-demand, price, cost, supplier analysis, risk analysis etc. for the given spend category and analyze the data to derive actionable solutions for the category managers. Understanding assignment scope, conduct desktop & primary research on the relevant industry to understand its dynamics. Develop “solution design” for the sourcing assignments, in collaboration with the team. Working closely with the client in developing actionable sourcing strategies for spend category. Using frameworks such as Porter’s five forces, SWOT, PESTLE, etc. to understand industry dynamics and competitor landscape. Ensuring that the projects are delivered at top-notch quality and client’s requirement are met without compromising on quality.
